en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, fromhis father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hammad, from Zurara who said,
‘I saw upon Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> some dyed clothes, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> (just) married a woman from Qureysh’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from Zurarah who has said the following: “
I once saw abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, in al-Mu‘asfar (dye with safflower) dress and he (the Imam) said that he has just married a woman from Quraysh/”
